integrity: Proof uses an unrestricted three-move Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé strategy, exact intersection parameters, a complete twelve-signature realizability argument, and a sharp small-order obstruction; finite code is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only nontrivial simple strongly regular graphs in the pure adjacency/equality language and quantifier rank at most three.
No stronger-rank, counting-logic, or algorithmic graph-isomorphism claim.
Possible unindexed or folklore overlap; independent audit not performed.
title: Twelve rank-three theories of strongly regular graphs and a sharp ten-vertex kernel
